input: After one burden lands, what exactly changes locally, and what has to be reread before the next operation?

bridge_terms.D0: The surface request asks about the local transition after burden landing.
bridge_terms.PsiN: The encoded state distinguishes the landed local result from the downstream reread state.
bridge_terms.expanded_IR: The expanded bridge keeps local burden delta and dependency-radius delta separate without adding hard register fields.
bridge_terms.Delta-kappa: Delta-kappa is the dependency-radius change consumed by R(H,Delta), not the same thing as the local burden result.
bridge_terms.burden_notation: The landed burden-cycle is complete only after its submoves contribute to the local Delta-nB.
bridge_terms.operator_signature: Each local transition must preserve target -> operation -> result before naming Delta-nB.
bridge_terms.expanded_R: R(H,Delta) consumes local Delta-nB plus Delta-kappa before selecting STOP/HOLD/PARTIAL/RECURSE.

control_effects.hold_release: Hold the next topic until the local transition and dependency reread are separated.
control_effects.burden_selection: Select the next burden only after R(H,Delta) consumes Delta-kappa.
control_effects.reread: The transition forces a post-burden reread before closure or recursion.
control_effects.partial_behavior: If the reread leaves unresolved dependency pressure, mark PARTIAL rather than COMPLETE.

local_transition.Delta-nB: local landed state change from target -> operation -> result
local_transition.Delta-kappa: dependency-radius change reread before the next decision
local_transition.distinction: Delta-nB is not Delta-kappa; both feed R(H,Delta) before STOP/HOLD/PARTIAL/RECURSE

ir_projection.load_bearing_node: local transition cannot license next burden until dependency radius is reread
ir_projection.what_is_withheld_and_why: The next burden is held until Delta-nB and Delta-kappa are distinguished and consumed by R(H,Delta).

post_render_gate.cleared_this_pass: local Delta-nB versus Delta-kappa distinction recorded
post_render_gate.remaining_live_distortions: next operation remains dependent on post-delta reread
post_render_gate.next_eligible_pass: apply post-delta reread to select the next burden
